note: Wichita County KS (seat Leoti) publishes no queryable zoning district service. arcgis search for zoning and Leoti/Wichita County returned nothing in the county. Leoti's site lists zoning ordinance PDFs (2020-2026 zoning changes) and a gworks GIS viewer with no discoverable zoning service. Kansas ORKA covers parcels only. The City of Wichita/Sedgwick County zoning layers cover a different county.
